title: Length bound for processing a clause's literals
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathit{lits}$ be a list of literals on $n$ variables each paired with its position index, let $\mathit{path}$ be a list of variable–direction pairs, and let $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$ be restrictions on $n$ variables. Running the clause-processing procedure on $\mathit{lits}$, $\mathit{path}$, $\rho_0$, and $\sigma$ yields, among its outputs, a remaining path and a list of accumulated auxiliary pairs. The length of the auxiliary list plus the length of the remaining path is at most the length of $\mathit{path}$.
hypotheses_covered: a list of literals paired with position indices
a path list of variable–direction pairs
two restrictions ρ₀ and σ on n variables
replaced:
The aux output length of $\mathrm{processClauseLits}$ plus the remaining path
length never exceeds the initial path length.
